## Example 4.1 · Daily compounding {#fm4-example-4-1-d .fm-slide }

Find the total value of an investment if \$8000 is invested at

d) 5% p.a. compounded daily for 4 years

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 10–11 · Example 4.1 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
Assume 365 compounding periods per year. $r=5/365$, $n=1460$. $A=8000(1+0.05/365)^{1460}\approx\$9771.09$. Use the calculator expression with full precision.
:::
